description: Allowlisted public discovery sources for Raksha Atlas. Direct feeds/APIs only; no login bypass or collection of private material. Items are ingested as unreviewed candidates.

rssFeeds.name: PIB RSS — Government of India releases
rssFeeds.notes: Official primary releases. The RSS entry is metadata/snippet; open the original release for full context.

rssFeeds.name: Google News discovery — ANI defence coverage
rssFeeds.notes: Search index used to discover stories; verify at the publisher and primary source.

rssFeeds.name: Google News discovery — All India Radio / News on AIR
rssFeeds.notes: Search index, not a direct AIR feed; AIR News is a public broadcaster but discovery results must be checked against the linked item.

rssFeeds.name: Google News discovery — IDRW
rssFeeds.notes: Secondary reporting. Keep claims unverified until corroborated.

rssFeeds.name: Google News discovery — India Today defence
rssFeeds.notes: Secondary reporting; citations link to the publisher item where available.

rssFeeds.name: Google News discovery — The Indian Express defence
rssFeeds.notes: Secondary reporting; verify programme milestones with primary documentation.

rssFeeds.name: Google News discovery — The Hindu defence
rssFeeds.notes: Secondary reporting; verify programme milestones with primary documentation.

rssFeeds.name: Google News discovery — named defence channels and reporters
rssFeeds.notes: Name-based search can return lookalikes or unrelated people. Treat as a discovery lead and verify account identity before citing.

rssFeeds.name: Google News discovery — international defence outlets
rssFeeds.notes: Secondary/international reporting. Headlines/snippets are retained, not full article text.

rssFeeds.name: Indian Defence News — Publisher RSS
rssFeeds.notes: Publisher Blogger RSS feed. Secondary curated reporting; preserve article labels/bylines and underlying source attribution. Do not treat claims as verified without primary corroboration.

youtube.notes: Requires YOUTUBE_API_KEY. API returns public video metadata, not a guaranteed transcript. Channel identity and claims remain reported until reviewed.

xApi.notes: Requires X_BEARER_TOKEN and exact public usernames. Recent Search access depends on the current X API plan. No logged-in browser scraping is used.

liveWebSearch.notes: Chat can use OpenAI Responses API web_search when OPENAI_API_KEY is configured. A query-time search result is cited in the answer but is not silently auto-published to the site's article feed.
